# LKD: Linux kernel on Darwin. Builds liblkd.a and one test executable per tests/test_*.c.
# Module agents only add files: src/<module>/*.c and tests/test_<module>_*.c are picked up by glob.
# Do not edit this file; write a request in docs/requests/ instead.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(lkd C)

if(NOT APPLE OR NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "arm64|aarch64")
  message(WARNING "LKD targets arm64 macOS; other hosts are not supported")
endif()

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS ON)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Debug)
endif()

set(LKD_WARN -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter -Werror=implicit-function-declaration
    -Werror=incompatible-pointer-types -Werror=int-conversion)
set(LKD_COMMON_FLAGS -std=gnu11 -fno-omit-frame-pointer -D_DARWIN_C_SOURCE ${LKD_WARN})

# Every module source is compiled into the library. SOURCES are globbed on every configure.
file(GLOB_RECURSE LKD_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.c)
add_library(lkd STATIC ${LKD_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(lkd PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
                                      PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/include)
target_compile_options(lkd PRIVATE ${LKD_COMMON_FLAGS})
set_target_properties(lkd PROPERTIES ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lib OUTPUT_NAME lkd)

# Test support (fake engine, helpers): tests/support/*.c, shared by every test.
file(GLOB_RECURSE LKD_SUPPORT_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/support/*.c)
if(LKD_SUPPORT_SOURCES)
  add_library(lkdtest STATIC ${LKD_SUPPORT_SOURCES})
  target_include_directories(lkdtest PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/support
                                            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/include)
  target_compile_options(lkdtest PRIVATE ${LKD_COMMON_FLAGS})
  set_target_properties(lkdtest PROPERTIES ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lib)
endif()

# One executable per tests/test_*.c. liblkd.a is force-loaded: the module hooks are weak symbols
# in core and strong in the modules, and a plain archive link would not pull the strong ones.
file(GLOB LKD_TEST_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/test_*.c)
set(LKD_TEST_TARGETS "")
foreach(src ${LKD_TEST_SOURCES})
  get_filename_component(name ${src} NAME_WE)
  add_executable(${name} ${src})
  target_include_directories(${name} PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests
                             ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/include)
  target_compile_options(${name} PRIVATE ${LKD_COMMON_FLAGS})
  if(TARGET lkdtest)
    target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE lkdtest)
  endif()
  target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE "-Wl,-force_load,$<TARGET_FILE:lkd>")
  add_dependencies(${name} lkd)
  # force_load hides the library from the dependency scanner: relink when liblkd.a or the support library changes.
  set_property(TARGET ${name} APPEND PROPERTY LINK_DEPENDS $<TARGET_FILE:lkd>)
  if(TARGET lkdtest)
    set_property(TARGET ${name} APPEND PROPERTY LINK_DEPENDS $<TARGET_FILE:lkdtest>)
  endif()
  set_target_properties(${name} PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/tests)
  # No codesign step: the Apple linker signs arm64 binaries ad hoc by itself.
  list(APPEND LKD_TEST_TARGETS ${name})
endforeach()

# 'check' builds everything, then runs each test program under a timeout.
add_custom_target(check
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/run_tests.sh ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/tests
  DEPENDS ${LKD_TEST_TARGETS}
  USES_TERMINAL)
